text: A Segal type in simplicial type theory is one where:
choices: the type of composites hom(a,b) × hom(b,c) → hom(a,c) is contractible
the inner horn filling condition holds: Λ²₁ → A has a contractible space of fillers
there is exactly one morphism between any two points
explanation: Segal types satisfy: for every composable pair (f:a→b, g:b→c), the type of witness arrows h:a→c together with 2-simplices filling the horn is contractible. This is ∞-categorical composition.
